versionFieldNote: Machine-checked by extraction/verify_all.py: allowlistVersion (must equal tokens/llm/component-allowlist.json version), tokenCatalogVersion, tokenPolicyVersion, and the whole counts block. Documentation-only, hand-maintained, nothing verifies them: repositoryVersion, pageSpecVersion, tokenVersion, sectionRegistryVersion, componentRegistryVersion, assetRegistryVersion. The wrapper-gate thresholds live in extraction/wrapper_gate.py and are enforced, not versioned.

sourceProject.name: Glaze landing clone (React 18, Vite 5, Tailwind 3.4)
sourceProject.description: Study clone of a real, live commercial site (Glaze by Raycast). Brand marks, copy, app icons, avatars and screenshots are not licensed for reuse; see assets/asset-roles.json.

scope.deliberatelyNotModelled: All other routes in the repo-level IA (pricing, download, awards, legal, blog, changelog, store, app detail). They were being specced and built concurrently. See README 'Adding a template'.

excludedFromPackage: *.zip (design-repo.zip is a build artifact, regenerate last, never commit)

dependencies.note: Verification needs no node tooling. Install with: python3 -m pip install jsonschema. Only extraction/measure_section_heights.mjs (optional evidence tool that re-records section heights from a running build) needs Playwright.
